LanguageData.RC_Text_50e075878c625479: Hold until the allied defensive positions are established
LanguageData.RC_Text_eef7110521983ace: The outpost is in place. Use the local steel to build your defenses and draw them in.
LanguageData.RC_Text_358bbe5fa59f75a6: Our allies need time to establish their defenses. Hold the four entrances. We will tell you when extraction is available.
LanguageData.RC_Text_27ff2ef33df70fc4: The allied defenses are ready. You may extract now or keep holding the line.
LanguageData.RC_Text_4eb5216e96744311: Our allies are secure. Executing group recall.
LanguageData.RC_Text_310374c47f8e1bf0: The outpost has fallen: all replicators and probes have been destroyed.
LanguageData.RC_Text_123998f2b0879aad: Executor, as you instructed, we have contacted Knight Cassandra. Her troops will immediately establish defenses around the stabilized subnode.
LanguageData.RC_Text_d7ee7fb5c722aa11: The Purifiers will brave any danger for you, Executor. We have found an ideal location, surrounded by mountains, with four Romulus subnodes nearby.
LanguageData.RC_Text_52830fbb8ab088f4: Gestalt is at your command. We will draw the Legion troops toward you. Our teams are in position near the subnodes, ready to strike on your order.
LanguageData.RC_Text_9df05e148e7ccf9e: Bravo-0-6 ready. I have the northeast. Adler and Bell have the southeast.
LanguageData.RC_Text_bb5d5df9765b2337: Zimo and I have the northwest.
LanguageData.RC_Text_ca7c5f5e69677ee3: You said it, mate. By the way, sir, Karma and Wei Lin have already headed southwest.
LanguageData.RC_Text_7d10696f58c742ce: The assault will be fierce, but we trust your judgment. The longer we hold them here, the stronger the Empire can make its positions.
LanguageData.RC_Text_90bcf061efee2267: We are short on time, Executor. The enemy will soon overrun our positions. Until then, we need to delay them as long as possible.
LanguageData.RC_Text_6309262f9fe0ee2a: We need defenses to hold them back. There are rich mineral deposits here; we can convert resources with the replicator.
LanguageData.RC_Text_56d2346c58007c59: Executor, the Legion is gathering to the southwest.
LanguageData.RC_Text_c3264728b270a5e4: The enemy is upon us! Warriors, ready your blades!
LanguageData.RC_Text_13bcd81e12ea0751: Commander, the Legion has reached the northwest and is preparing to assault our base.
LanguageData.RC_Text_2ddd2a13adfaca2b: Executor, Legion troops detected to the southeast.
LanguageData.RC_Text_c6f3a4aecc563dc4: The Legion took the bait, sir. They are gathering northeast of the base.
LanguageData.RC_Text_daf0d4f22cbe7e88: You cannot withstand the wrath of the god of war!
LanguageData.RC_Text_ca29369a4f3c2dae: We will crush your fragile defenses.
LanguageData.RC_Text_8d062f2553f7c295: Your futile resistance will bring you only annihilation.
LanguageData.RC_Text_0a3d4c6c8ab647b3: For the glory of the god of war! Charge!
LanguageData.RC_Text_e8711def89f39246: This is not good... Romulus has sent his champion.
LanguageData.RC_Text_a49ca9bdcb67243f: The enemy has deployed a champion warrior.
LanguageData.RC_Text_a177d5d2d364ff8f: Executor, Bravo-0-6 here. A champion warrior is heading for our base.
LanguageData.RC_Text_c2d9f2922878883d: Commander, a champion warrior is approaching our base.
LanguageData.RC_Text_e36203aa6d2e2253: Sir, a champion warrior is coming.
LanguageData.RC_Text_192e2a5c753fe252: Thank you for your support, Executor. Our initial defenses are in place. Construction is proceeding smoothly.
LanguageData.RC_Text_2798d28bb350cb48: The heavy turrets and structural walls have been reinforced. We are almost ready, Executor.
LanguageData.RC_Text_c38a94a93318dda9: The logistics system is ready. Almost done, Executor. Just a little longer.
LanguageData.RC_Text_6e33fb1253a75f71: Our positions are ready, Executor. You may withdraw at any time. Thank you for your support.
LanguageData.RC_Text_a848b62f4650a0c7: You heard the order, warriors! Execute mass recall!
LanguageData.PMP_M5_AttractedTip: A strategic attraction score, not the number of pawns in the next wave.
LanguageData.PMP_M5_BuildHint: Mine → store → replicate and convert → defend
